name: Giant Fluffy Rice Cooker Pancake

instructions.primary_message: In a large bowl, whisk flour, sugar, baking powder, and salt until combined. In a medium bowl, whisk milk, egg, butter, and vanilla until well combined. Pour egg mixture into flour mixture and stir gently until just combined (batter should remain lumpy with a few streaks of flour). Let batter sit for 10 to 15 minutes before cooking.

Lightly spray the rice cooker insert of an 8-cup rice cooker. Add batter and cover cooker with lid. Cook on the rice setting according to the manufacturer's instructions until the pancake has lightly pulled away from the edges, and a toothpick inserted in the center comes out clean, 40 to 45 minutes, checking periodically and restarting the rice setting as needed if the cooker switches off.

Uncover the rice cooker and turn it off and let pancake cool slightly, about 5 minutes. Then carefully invert rice cooker insert on a large serving plate to turn out the pancake. Slice and serve hot or warm with butter and maple syrup.

description: Learn how to make a rice cooker pancake that cooks in one piece, with a soft, even crumb and no flipping required.
notes:
Optional or for serving: Salted butter, for serving; Maple syrup, for serving

Make-ahead and storage: Pancakes are best enjoyed while they're still warm. To store any leftover portions of the pancake that have not been topped with maple syrup and butter, separate them with paper or foil between each piece before wrapping tightly in plastic wrap or storing in a zipper-lock freezer bag and freeze up to 3 weeks.
author: Laila Ibrahim
